Text: {Dis(Character)} returning home to report on {his(Character)} assignment, but {his(Character)} shuttle’s flightpath is erratic

“{Character}!” you bark into the viewscreen. “Get that shuttle back on target!”

“My {Up(title(PlayerCharacter))}!” {he(Character)} gasps. “My magnificent, glorious {Up(title(PlayerCharacter))}, anything for you!”

{His(Character)} trajectory improves, and {he(Character)} lands without incident.

They find a case bearing the insignia of the pre-Collapse R&D group NovaCorp, and a vial of grey powder. Once {d_s(Character)} mental state is recovered, you question {him(Character)}.

“I chanced upon an abandoned laboratory in {AssignmentSystem}; the case was inside. When I took it... Indescribable! The awe, the admiration I felt for anyone I saw - what sublime creatures!”

There isn't much powder left, but you could put it to use.
